label: early copy phase, output of 4th original token (recall_idx 3) in long sequences
explanation: Copy-phase-only positional feature (100% of mass in copy phase; never fires in original phase or on <DEL>). Peaks at recall_idx 3 (80% of mass, rate 29%), with spillover at recall_idx 2 (6%) and 4 (12%); essentially silent for L<=5 and at the last two copy steps. Within the recall_idx 3 window it fires on only ~43% of steps: content-dependent gating with a broad, weak token preference (out_tok s/p/d/m/r/k ~3-4x lift, next_out h/r/i/p/m), but no compact token set captures it (a 10-token out_tok set gives precision 0.56 but loses half the recall). Strongest activations occur at recall_idx 2-3 in L=8-9 sequences. Not dependent on digits, repeats, or correctness.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the next token to output (most: h, r, i, p, m, b; least: q, w, c, -) and the token being output, by phase (delimiter step: q, d, c, f; copy phase: s, p, d, k; input phase: ); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, L=9, L=8 & t=10.
